observations.title: Rincon de la Vieja volcano (Costa Rica)
observations.description: The Observatorio Vulcanológico y Sismológico de Costa Rica-Universidad Nacional (OVSICORI-UNA) reported that a total of 67 small phreatic eruptions at Rincón de la Vieja were recorded daily by the seismic and infrasound networks during 6-16 September. One of the eruptive events at 1032 on 6 September generated a lahar; secondary lahars were recorded on 5 and 6 September after heavy rainfall. On 13 September the sulfur dioxide flux exceeded 6,000 tonnes per day. The Alert Level remained at 3 (Caution) and the Aviation Color Code remained Orange. Source: Observatorio Vulcanologico y Sismologico de Costa Rica-Universidad Nacional (OVSICORI-UNA)
